sandevistan.tooltip.immuno.1: Needs cyberpsychosis. Restores 20 current Mind; each dose lasts its own 1 minute.
sandevistan.tooltip.immuno.2: Lowers cyberpsychosis by up to 40; when each dose ends you lose 5 Mind for good and part of the cyberpsychosis comes back. Hold sneak and hit another player to inject it into them. Using several in a row (within 3 minutes) makes it weaker.
sandevistan.mindzero: Your Mind hit 0%! It hurts (3 hearts), and using it now costs 2 hearts every 8 s of use while cyberpsychosis keeps building.
sandevistan.psy.on: The cyberpsychosis symptoms are setting in...
sandevistan.psy.limit: CYBERPSYCHOSIS AT 100%! It can still go higher.

sandevistan.remedy.noimplant: You do not have a Sandevistan implanted.
sandevistan.tooltip.stabilizer.1: Heals 5 Mind right away and gives Good Mind for 1 minute
sandevistan.tooltip.stabilizer.2: With Good Mind, each second has a 1% chance to heal 1 Mind, and it lowers cyberpsychosis
sandevistan.immuno.used: Immunosuppressant: +%s current Mind and -%s cyberpsychosis for now.
sandevistan.immuno.end: A dose wore off: you lost %s Mind for good and %s cyberpsychosis came back.

sandevistan.implant.tip.1: Slows everything around you by 85% while you move normally.
sandevistan.implant.tip.2: Absurd speed, jump and mining; Strength, Haste, Resistance and Night Vision.
sandevistan.implant.tip.3: Dodges 50% of attacks and projectiles, hits harder knockback, and eating, drinking and bows are faster.
sandevistan.implant.tip.4: Costs Mind (5 to turn on). Overuse causes cyberpsychosis.

sandevistan.tooltip.arm.1: Melee damage +3 (swords, axes, tools and fists).
sandevistan.tooltip.arm.2: Does not affect bows or thrown items.
sandevistan.tooltip.arm.3: Pick the right or left arm at the Ripperdoc. Your arm becomes an iron block.
sandevistan.tooltip.neural.1: Lets you use up to 2 different chips.
sandevistan.tooltip.neural.2: Right-click a chip to insert it; remove it in the implants tab. No doctor needed.
sandevistan.tooltip.chip.1: Right-click to insert it into the Neural Link.
